name: agent-instructions
description: Set up any repository for AI coding agents end to end and keep it right: one canonical AGENTS.md with CLAUDE.md importing it, knowledge in docs, one path-rule source generated for every tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity, Devin, Cline, Kiro, CodeRabbit), skills, MCP, cloud-agent and review-bot setup, and a CI check; plus auditing, slimming and probe-testing instruction files, and generator-safe layouts for Laravel Boost and friends.
